component.name: Nulavio
component.summary: The Linux browser that is protected from the start
O navegador para Linux que já vem protegido

description.p: Nulavio is an open-source desktop browser for Linux, built from Mozilla's signature-verified Firefox source. It blocks ads and trackers from the first launch, keeps each part of your life in its own profile, and sends nothing to servers of its own: there is no telemetry and no Nulavio account.

ul.li: Ad and tracker blocking from the first start
Profiles for work, personal life and sensitive sites, each with its own color
Firefox's engine and extensions, with security updates within days of Mozilla's

description.p: In the Flatpak, the encrypted profiles (Vault) and the confined mode are not available: they need programs outside the sandbox. Password-manager apps work when the system has xdg-native-messaging-proxy.
